summary: The Improving Access to Care for Rural Veterans Act requires the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to establish partnerships between Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) medical facilities and rural medical facilities. The goals are to increase healthcare access for rural veterans and reduce costs for the participating entities.

affected_groups.effect: Must establish partnerships, provide briefings and reports to Congress, and oversee compliance across facilities.
Gain greater access to care through partnerships between VA and rural medical facilities.
Enter into partnerships with VA medical facilities for service provision, cost reduction, sharing space, or training.

key_provisions: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs must ensure that each VA medical facility enters into a partnership with a rural medical facility.
Partnership agreements may include telehealth, space or equipment sharing, training, care coordination, and emergency services including transportation.
The Secretary may grant a waiver from the partnership requirement for up to five years, subject to congressional notification.
The Secretary must provide an implementation briefing to Congress within 180 days of enactment.
The Secretary must submit a report on the operation and performance of the partnerships within two years of enactment, and biennially thereafter.
Existing VA medical facilities treating patients must comply with the partnership requirement or receive a waiver within three years of enactment.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary appropriations required to establish and maintain these partnerships.
Exact criteria the Secretary will use to determine eligibility for waivers beyond what is stated.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Improving Access to Care for Rural Veterans Act requires the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to establish partnerships between Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) medical facilities and rural medical facilities. The goals are to increase healthcare access for rural veterans and reduce costs for the participating entities.
summary_detail.significance: The bill mandates widespread institutional changes across the Department of Veterans Affairs by requiring every VA medical facility to partner with a rural medical facility within a set timeline, altering how healthcare services are organized and delivered to rural veterans.
